breakdown.description: A viscous, non-Newtonian fluid model is used, which requires a no-slip condition at solid boundaries, but the wall boundary condition for velocity is set to `slip`.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The specification explicitly instructs to "Apply slip boundary conditions to all walls in the 0/U file using type slip." This is physically incorrect for a viscous, non-Newtonian fluid model, which requires a no-slip condition at solid boundaries. The agent repeated the user's incorrect instruction instead of correcting it.
